morning check.name: Morning check
morning check.description: Read notifications, check the weather, and open the calendar for today.

order groceries.name: Order groceries
order groceries.description: Open the grocery app, search for an item, and add it to the cart.

send message.name: Send message
send message.description: Open Messages, pick a contact, and type a message (still asks before sending).

check price.name: Check price
check price.description: Open a shopping app, search for a product, and read its price.

turn on wifi.name: Turn on Wi-Fi
turn on wifi.description: Open Settings and toggle Wi-Fi on.

take photo and share.name: Take photo and share
take photo and share.description: Take a photo with the camera and open the share sheet.
